description.value:
You grew up in one of the First World's legendary performing troupes. They might have been musicians, actors, or a merry band of tricksters, but above all that, they were your family. You watched them play for all kinds of audiences, from powerful fey to ghosts and swarms of dragonflies. However, now you're no longer in the band. For you, the revels have ended. Perhaps you discovered a dark secret of the troupe and fled. Maybe a fellow cast member grew jealous and had you removed. It might even be that you betrayed their trust. That part of your life is over. Whether you resent them or desire to rejoin, you have a new goal now. You intend to become the greatest performer you can so you can show the troupe just what they missed.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Performance skill and the Fey Lore skill. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Fascinating Performance] skill feat.
